accepted_for: failure diagnosis and post-attempt preservation reconciliation only
scope: Independently reconcile the exact first installer attempt, its masked primary failure, owned cleanup and later unchanged repository/private-file observations. This result cannot satisfy successful installation or installed-review gates.

transport.records: Complete stdout contains the preliminary preflight plus the exact logical failed supervisor result. Decoded child invocation matches the accepted installer, products, stage inputs and ports. Raw driver stdout is empty; complete driver stderr is retained.

failure.location: windows-install-tray-host-20261125.ps1 line 281, backend iteration, before repository_preflight is recorded for the backend
failure.persisted_preceding_event: Only the app repository_preflight event was committed to install-result.json; it records original app HEAD and user-fork remote main 459a74537cbbe1dff521c6fc7ad1ce3ec2890683.
failure.meaning: The local native origin refers to the same upstream repository using SSH. The exact-string guard refused the observed spelling. No remote change is required; the fixed explicit HTTPS user-fork publication URLs are separate.
failure.secondary_error: Save-Result calls File.Replace(temporary,destination,$null) after the destination exists. That invocation throws The path is not of a legal form during failure recording/finally and prevents normal final stdout, obscuring the primary error. The exact pending result independently retains the primary refusal.
failure.secondary_correction_gate: Root will qualify the narrowly corrected null-string argument on a disposable PS5.1 file replacement before a separately named corrected installer is accepted.

preservation.source_and_private_comparison: The complete parsed repos, preserved_files, preserved_private_files, settings, environment_files and relevant_processes values are identical before and after the attempt. This includes both exact HEADs/raw index hashes, required candidate ancestry, all fifteen byte/hash records and their exact dirty-status inventory, existing .env.local, old native pin and both Git config hashes.
preservation.git_config_scope: Git config equality is between retained 08:20:38 and 08:57:07 observations. No separately retained pre-fetch config comparison is asserted.
preservation.original_app_status: Same four modified and eleven untracked files; no newly staged source.
preservation.control_flow: The primary refusal precedes source/index/config backup creation and all index adoption, source fast-forward, runtime swap, pin copy/selection and remote push operations. No preservation_ready or later mutation event appears. The output contains only the two result files and owner marker; no backup directory or mutation record exists.

resource_assessment: The 9.083-second failed run stayed below 512 MiB aggregate with more than 3 GiB baseline/immediate and more than 1 GiB observed live free memory. All fifteen sampled owned identities exited. The outer Job used no assisted cleanup, recorded no cleanup errors and ended empty. The sampled Git exit 1 alone is not diagnosed as an error because missing optional configuration may validly return 1.
decision: Failure and unchanged-state reconciliation PASS; installation FAILED. Keep the original attempt immutable. A separately named, independently reviewed compatibility copy may correct only the observed native origin literal and null-backup argument, with fresh one-shot output/supervisor bindings and all remaining product, preservation, push and resource guards intact. Its actual result remains a future gate.
